tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and dark fills (ink button, selected chip, selected segment, tooltip, toast). Reads on bg, card, paper, surface-2, panel.

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an ink fill.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page ground behind every screen; also the colour of the notch cut-out in a notch card.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: White floating surface (menus, popovers, inputs on cards).

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Inset field fill (.inp). Text: ink; placeholder: text-2.

tokens.name: surface-3
tokens.usage: Hover fill of rows, buttons and menu items.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Flat card on the ground (.card, .lcard, .empty). Text: ink, text-2.

tokens.name: card-2
tokens.usage: Card hover and nested card fill.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Floating panels, secondary buttons, panes, chips (same as surface).

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Control fill: segmented track, select, icon-hover background.

tokens.name: panel-2
tokens.usage: Pressed or hovered control fill; muted badge.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and 1px control outlines (decorative, not the only cue).

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input hover border and swatch outlines.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Body text. Alias of ink. On bg, card, paper, surface-2 and panel.

tokens.name: text-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text, hints, meta. 4.5:1 or more on bg, card, paper, surface-2, panel in both themes.

tokens.name: text-3
tokens.usage: Decorative or disabled only (placeholder chevrons, pane chevron). Below 4.5:1 by design: never carry content in it.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Legacy alias of text-2. Do not use in new code.

tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Glyph sheet and editor stage. Stays light in both themes: glyphs are drawn dark.

tokens.name: canvas-on
tokens.usage: Selected glyph tile background on the sheet.

tokens.name: on-canvas-2
tokens.usage: Secondary ink drawn on the canvas.

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: Gap ring around the slider thumb; matches the surface it sits on.

tokens.name: track
tokens.usage: Slider track, off part.

tokens.name: track-on
tokens.usage: Slider track, filled part.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Brand red. Fills without text (dots, slider thumb, focus ring, selection), and text of 20px bold or more. Not for error states.

tokens.name: accent-press
tokens.usage: Background of .btn.pri, checked checkbox/radio/toggle and badge: white text on it is 4.69:1.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover of the filled accent button.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind accent text (.chip.soft, current menu item).

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Accent-coloured text on accent-soft, card and paper. Dark value lightened from the source #ff7167 (4.33:1) so the current menu item reaches 4.5:1.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent-press, accent-hover and accent fills (icons only on plain accent).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Soft halo drawn 4px around the accent focus ring.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors and proof issues; text and outline on paper. Distinct from the brand red.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on a danger fill (error badge).

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Hover tint of the danger button.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Success fill (dot, bar). No text on it.

tokens.name: ok-ink
tokens.usage: Success text on ok-soft, card and paper.

tokens.name: ok-soft
tokens.usage: Success tint background.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Warning fill (dot, bar). No text on it.

tokens.name: warn-text
tokens.usage: Warning text on warn-soft, card and paper.

tokens.name: warn-soft
tokens.usage: Warning tint background.

tokens.name: gv
tokens.usage: Vertical guide line colour on the editor canvas.

tokens.name: gh
tokens.usage: Horizontal guide line colour on the editor canvas.

tokens.name: glyph
tokens.usage: Glyph outline fill on the canvas (always dark: the sheet stays light).

tokens.name: glyph-dim
tokens.usage: Secondary or ghost glyph drawing on the canvas.

tokens.name: glyph-fill
tokens.usage: Selected contour fill on the canvas.

tokens.name: guide
tokens.usage: Metric guide lines (baseline, x-height, cap-height) on the canvas.

tokens.name: guide-dim
tokens.usage: 40px background grid of the editor stage.

tokens.name: cv-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text drawn on the canvas (read with dsColor).

tokens.name: cv-line
tokens.usage: Hairlines drawn on the canvas.

tokens.name: cv-panel
tokens.usage: Canvas overlay panel fill.

tokens.name: rail
tokens.usage: Rail pill background. A dark pill in both themes; icons use on-rail.

tokens.name: rail-2
tokens.usage: Rail button hover.

tokens.name: rail-hi
tokens.usage: Active rail button fill (icon turns rail colour).

tokens.name: on-rail
tokens.usage: Icons and tooltip text on the rail.

styles.name: hero
styles.usage: Home hero. In code --fs-hero = clamp(40px, 5.2vw, 76px); 76px is the desktop maximum.

styles.name: big-number
styles.usage: Big numbers and design-system page title (--fs-3xl).

styles.name: section-title
styles.usage: Section titles and the font name in the editor (--fs-2xl).

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Возьмите готовую гарнитуру и подстройте под себя.

styles.name: counter
styles.usage: Counters and badges. Never smaller than 11px (--fs-xs).

tokens.name: s1
tokens.usage: Hairline gaps, menu padding.

tokens.name: s2
tokens.usage: Gap between buttons and inline controls; pane stack gap.

tokens.name: s3
tokens.usage: Control side padding, chip padding, panel inset.

tokens.name: s4
tokens.usage: Card padding, button padding, pane padding.

tokens.name: s5
tokens.usage: Wide button padding, empty-state padding.

tokens.name: s6
tokens.usage: Section padding, gap between sections.

tokens.name: s7
tokens.usage: Page bottom padding.

tokens.name: s8
tokens.usage: Largest gap; end of long pages.

tokens.name: r-xs
tokens.usage: Menu items, tooltips, small bars.

tokens.name: r-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, tab chips, status badges.

tokens.name: r-md
tokens.usage: Panes, menus, popovers, glyph canvases.

tokens.name: r-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and surfaces. Also the notch-card corner.

tokens.name: r-xl
tokens.usage: Largest panels and hero blocks.

tokens.name: r-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, segmented controls, search, toast. Circles use 50%.

tokens.name: r-field
tokens.usage: The one radius for every search/text field with an inner icon or button (.srch, .srch.big, .psearch). Reference: home hero search. Variants change fill only.

shadow.note: Light lifts with soft grey shadows; dark uses hairline white rings instead of heavy shadows.

tokens.name: sh-1
tokens.usage: Hairline lift: cards and panes.

tokens.name: sh-2
tokens.usage: Floating panels, selected cards, slider thumb.

tokens.name: sh-3
tokens.usage: Popovers, menus, toast, tooltips.

tokens.name: fs-xs
tokens.usage: Counters, eyebrow. Floor: never below 11px.

tokens.name: fs-sm
tokens.usage: Tags, hints, tooltips.

tokens.name: fs-md
tokens.usage: Dense panels, chips, slider labels.

tokens.name: fs-base
tokens.usage: Base UI text.

tokens.name: fs-lg
tokens.usage: Pane titles, big search.

tokens.name: fs-xl
tokens.usage: Card titles.

tokens.name: fs-2xl
tokens.usage: Section titles.

tokens.name: fs-3xl
tokens.usage: Big numbers.

tokens.name: fs-hero
tokens.usage: Home hero heading.

tokens.name: fw-r
tokens.usage: Body text.

tokens.name: fw-m
tokens.usage: Controls, labels.

tokens.name: fw-sb
tokens.usage: Primary buttons, pane titles, tags.

tokens.name: fw-b
tokens.usage: Titles, badges.

tokens.name: lh-tight
tokens.usage: Headings and big numbers.

tokens.name: lh
tokens.usage: Body copy.

tokens.name: h-sm
tokens.usage: Small controls (.btn.sm, .chip.sm). Phone: 34px.

tokens.name: h-md
tokens.usage: Default control height. Phone: 44px.

tokens.name: h-lg
tokens.usage: Top-bar controls, icon buttons, pane header. Phone: 48px.

tokens.name: pad
tokens.usage: Outer gap of the app grid (phone: 12px).

tokens.name: rw
tokens.usage: Rail width.

tokens.name: nn
tokens.usage: Notch cut-out size on a notch card.

tokens.name: nr
tokens.usage: Concave corner radius of the notch.

tokens.name: nb
tokens.usage: Round arrow button inside the notch.
